input: Tell a client over the limit when to try again.
kindReason: One agent can build and verify it in one run.
title: Show when to try again
summary: A client over the rate limit sees when it may try again, on the admin page and in the reply.

stories.title: The banner on the admin page
stories.why: Operators look at the admin page first.

scenarios.then: a banner says try again in 60 s

proof.ref: /admin :: a 429 banner saying try again in 60 s

requirements.text: System MUST answer 429 with Retry-After when a tenant is over the limit.

success.text: An operator can tell when a tenant may send again without reading logs.
